result.summary: Identified one major content bug and one minor layout concern.

issues.description: The section header displays a technical identifier 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of human-readable text.
issues.suggestion: Map the string key to its intended localized value like 'Popular near you'.

issues.description: Horizontal category chips on the right edge are partially cut off.
issues.suggestion: Adjust container padding or use a gradient fade to indicate scrollable content.
